# Rohit Tirmanwar

> Software architect and hands-on tech lead who designs large-scale distributed systems on AWS serverless. Sr Lead Engineer at The College Board, leading a team of 6 to 8 engineers on Higher Ed and Financial Aid platforms used by millions of students worldwide. About 15 years of experience. Open to Staff and Principal Engineer roles.

## Experience

- May 2023 to present: Sr Lead Engineer, The College Board, Reston, Virginia. Architect and tech lead for Higher Ed and Financial Aid platforms. Owns end-to-end design of multiple distributed serverless services on AWS Lambda, API Gateway and DynamoDB, defined with AWS CDK in TypeScript. Leads 6 to 8 engineers. Shipped production AI features including an OCR document-processing pipeline and an AI chatbot.
- Apr 2021 to May 2023: Lead Software Engineer, Scadea Solutions, as a consultant embedded with The College Board on the same platforms. Designed and built serverless SaaS products on AWS with Node.js and React; led the development team.
- Jul 2019 to Apr 2021: Senior Software Engineer, then Lead Software Engineer (Jan 2021), PowerSchool, Arlington, Virginia. Full-stack engineer on K-12 education technology: React, Node.js, Express, GraphQL, MongoDB, AWS.
- Jul 2018 to Jul 2019: Front End Engineer, Folio Financial, McLean, Virginia. Owned the Angular and Node.js front end of a robo-advisor product; designed a white-label architecture with a GraphQL layer, Redux and an npm component library.
- Jan 2017 to May 2018: Graduate Research Assistant, George Mason University. Built a web application for a crowdsourced intelligence-analysis research project; scrum master for a team of five.
- Aug 2014 to Jul 2016: Lead Engineer, GE, Bengaluru, India.
- Jun 2011 to Jul 2014: Software Engineer, Geometric, Pune, India. C++ and Qt on computational-geometry CAD software.
